reason: Reviewed all five surfaces for two hook changes. (1) Handler names: Claude Code and Codex handlers now carry a statusMessage that names them; Codex installs that carry an integration revision keep their approved bytes and get no names, while installs without one (fresh since 14.4.2-beta.4) get names and Codex asks for approval once. Harness setup and CLI readiness: unchanged; the existing Codex approval reminder, doctor's native-approval-pending finding and `notifai doctor codex` already cover a changed handler, so no new instruction is needed. (2) Stop acknowledgement cap: a continuing Stop with another question pending now goes through the shared three-Stop acknowledgement hold instead of blocking on every Stop. Lifecycle hooks and the Notifai skill: unchanged; agents are already told to acknowledge an answer as soon as it arrives. Domain terms: unchanged.
